stories.title: The New Certification Scheme Helping Solar Farms Become Havens for Wildlife
stories.label: earth
stories.summary: A new certification scheme has launched to reward solar farm developers who design their sites to also support local wildlife. Instead of just rows of panels on bare ground, certified farms now include wildflower meadows, hedgerows, and ponds that give bees, birds, and small animals a place to thrive. It's a simple idea that turns clean energy sites into little nature reserves at the same time. Developers are already signing up, meaning more solar farms across the country will soon be doing double duty for the planet.
stories.why_good: It's a real, already-launched program that lets renewable energy and wildlife habitat grow side by side, with no political angle.

stories.title: Isle of Jersey Expands Marine Protections to Cover 21% of Territorial Waters
stories.label: ocean
stories.summary: The island of Jersey just made a big move to protect its seas. Officials expanded the area of ocean shielded from trawling and other damaging fishing from about 7% to nearly 22% of their waters. The new rules took effect on September 1st, giving fish, coral, and seafloor habitats room to recover and thrive. It's a real, binding change, not just a promise, and it shows how even a small island can make an outsized difference for ocean health.
stories.why_good: A concrete, already-in-force policy that triples protected ocean area, directly helping marine life recover.
